about_the_game:
a top down 2d game were you have to solve puzzles to advance into the level. collect items and use them in the inventory system by combining items together or performing an action with it to solve puzzle you face in the game.

you will encounter poems and textual puzzle where you have to move objects in specific manner or acquire specific items to solve puzzle in question

“Vasilisa the beautiful” is a Russian folklore story about a girl that lose her mother, her father remarried a cold-hearted women whom abuse Vasilisa with the help of her daughters, one day the daughters send Vasilisa into a mission to borrow light from the evil witch Baba Yaga, with the help of a magic talking doll given by Vasilisa's mother she have to get the light and return home safely.

based on some action you take in the game you will end up of one of three possible endings

the magic doll will give you hint if you get stuck in a puzzle, but only if you turn it on from the settings menu, for people who want to challenge themselves first.

short_description: Vasilisa a young beautiful girl, abused by her step-mother and step-sisters is forced to face Baba Yaga the human eating evil witch living in the woods. Could she get back home safely? collect items to solve puzzles you face along the journey and find the solution of textual based puzzles.
